decisions.reason: Adding Transak payment methods and allowing walletless fiat minting does not change secondary-sale royalty amounts, visibility, allocation, or ticket behavior.
The same-message INTRODUCE already fully represents the FAQ statement that Transak supports cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay without requiring existing crypto or a wallet.
Supported fiat payment methods and wallet requirements do not alter the mint price or allocation of mint revenue.
The fiat-mint payment-method decision does not change referral-code, ticket-counter, or badge metadata.
The source change concerns fiat checkout methods and wallet prerequisites, not Small Block prize values, funding, or draw conditions.
Walletless fiat minting and supported payment methods do not change badge milestones, storage, designs, or effects.
The source change does not alter Big Block prize amounts, pool target, eligible sales, or draw trigger.
Fiat mint payment options do not change the state transferred when an NFT is sold.
The payment-method decision does not change the mint-number basis or permanence of referral codes.
Transak payment support and walletless fiat minting do not change the selected Base blockchain or network layer.
The fiat checkout decision does not affect Chainlink VRF, ticket weighting, selection eligibility, or on-chain winner selection.
Supported fiat payment methods and wallet requirements do not affect the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
